summary: Jason Pizzino examines Bitcoin charts and sentiment indicators through the lens of 'double bluffs,' where price action makes new lows while market sentiment diverges. He compares historical bear market cycles from 2018 onward, analyzing durations of market moves down versus upward rallies, and reviews Fear and Greed Index readings at cycle lows. The analyst then assesses S&P 500 and Bitcoin charts using megaphone patterns, Fibonacci retracements, and historical cycle comparisons from 2011 to 2022. Finally, he evaluates S&P 500 indicator curves alongside current Bitcoin macro downtrend structures, emphasizing an objective approach without emotional bias.
digest_it: Jason Pizzino analizza i grafici di Bitcoin ed S&P 500 studiando i doppi bluff, i pattern a megafono e i cicli storici di mercato per valutare la tenuta dei minimi recenti. Esamina gli indici di paura e avidità, i ritracciamenti di Fibonacci e le curve degli indicatori macroeconomici. Conclude invitando a mantenere un approccio oggettivo sui mercati, evidenziando che sono necessari ulteriori segnali di forza prima di confermare un'inversione rialzista.
tone_evidence: He repeatedly states that the market needs more evidence, higher resistance breaks, and objective chart reading rather than emotional bias to confirm a major turnaround.

key_points.point: Double bluff pattern shows price making a new low while sentiment or momentum diverges positively.
Historical analysis shows upward rallies in bear markets often last longer in time than downward price drops.
Fear and Greed Index reading was 13 to 12 around recent lows, mirroring prior capitulation events.
Bitcoin needs to hold the 71,200 level, representing the 50 percent retracement from the all-time high to the cycle low, to avoid a breakdown toward 55,000.
Historical cycle comparisons across 2018, 2022, and earlier years suggest that fourth-quarter corrections often experience temporary relief bounces before stabilizing.
CME FedWatch tool indicates nearly 100 percent probability of an interest rate increase at the December 9 FOMC meeting.
S&P 500 futures show a minor double-bottom setup following a 12.5 percent pullback from top to bottom.
Bitcoin faces a potential continuation of a macro downtrend if significant levels separating bear and bull phases are not reclaimed.

moments.claim: Double bluffs at cycle lows indicate slowing selling pressure despite prevailing fear.
moments.details: The author explains the double bluff pattern on daily charts where price makes a lower low while sentiment diverges, showing that actual buyer activity differs from market fear. He looks at past instances in June where price dipped to 58,000 and 57,700 before reversing upward.
moments.surprise: Sentiment readings can improve slightly even as price drops to new local lows.
moments.scenario: Price drops to a low, retests or breaks slightly lower with improving sentiment, then reverses upward.
moments.conclusion: Double bluffs provide early clues about potential trend reversals at cycle lows.

moments.claim: Bear market rallies last longer in time than the preceding downward price drops.
moments.details: The speaker reviews previous market drops such as the tariff crash low in March-April and September lows, noting that upward recovery moves take significantly more weeks than the sharp drops down. He highlights that downward moves are short in time but big in price decline, whereas upward moves are long in time and smaller in price acceleration.
moments.surprise: Upward corrective moves in bear markets take more than double the time of the crash down.
moments.conclusion: Bear market rallies test investor patience by taking much longer to unfold than sharp drops.

history.story: A capitulation dump in November 2018 caused a 50% collapse in a few days, followed by a higher low recovery.
history.parallel: Shows how bear markets repeat similar double bluff structures at major lows.

moments.claim: Recent November lows show similar sentiment readings to past cycle bottoms.
moments.details: Examining late November price action around Thanksgiving, the Fear and Greed Index registered between 11 and 13 near the lows. The author notes that these readings match previous capitulation points that preceded multi-week recovery phases.
moments.surprise: Fear and Greed Index remained near 11 to 13 during consecutive local lows.
moments.scenario: Price tests low around 58,000 with low fear readings, followed by a sideways consolidation or bounce.
moments.conclusion: Watching whether the market quickly reverses after testing lows will confirm if a new bounce is starting.

moments.claim: Bitcoin's price action displays a broadening megaphone formation indicating escalating volatility and a macro downtrend.
moments.details: The speaker demonstrates how broadening formations feature higher highs and lower lows. He notes that if Bitcoin fails to hold current cycle lows, the next major support zone sits around 71,200 dollars, which represents the 50 percent retracement from the all-time high.
moments.surprise: The megaphone pattern highlights escalating volatility that frequently leads to prolonged bearish consolidation.
moments.scenario: If price holds 71,200, it could rally toward 75,000; if it loses support, it may retest the 55,000 low.
moments.conclusion: The market remains in a macro downtrend until key resistance levels are reclaimed.

moments.claim: Comparing Bitcoin cycles from 2011 through 2022 reveals consistent fourth-quarter correction and consolidation patterns.
moments.details: He reviews multiple previous halving cycles, showing how markets typically bottom out around November before forming higher lows and attempting recovery moves into the new year.
moments.surprise: Despite varying macroeconomic conditions, historical cycle curves show remarkable behavioral similarities during fourth-quarter periods.
moments.conclusion: History suggests the current pain phase may be short-lived, though substantial confirmation is still required.

history.story: After peaking in late 2017, Bitcoin corrected sharply through 2018, found a cyclical low in November 2018, consolidated through December and January, and initiated a sustained rally in early spring 2019.
history.parallel: Current fourth-quarter price action mirrors the consolidation and bounce phases observed in previous mid-term cycle years.

moments.topic: S&P 500 futures and Fed interest rates
moments.claim: S&P 500 futures exhibit a potential double-bottom low while FedWatch data prices in near-certain rate hikes.
moments.details: The S&P 500 dropped roughly 12.5 percent from its peak. Concurrently, CME FedWatch data for the December 9 meeting shows a nearly 100 percent probability of rate increases, creating divergence with recovering price action.
moments.surprise: Markets continue anticipating interest rate hikes even after suffering a 15 percent correction on indices like the Nasdaq.
moments.scenario: If the S&P 500 breaks above 7,300 to 7,400 points, it confirms buyer return; failure risks retesting recent lows.
moments.conclusion: Indices are attempting to form a bottom, but conclusive topping pattern invalidation requires higher resistance breaks.

moments.claim: The S&P 500 is experiencing a slow grind into Q4 lacking the strength of prior strong readings.
moments.details: Comparing actual data to historical curves from 1926 to 2026, the speaker points out higher lows forming but notes that fourth-quarter strength remains subdued compared to historical expectations.
moments.surprise: Current price action fails to match the historically stronger Q4 momentum.
moments.scenario: A modest rally could occur, but it is not expected to reach new all-time highs.
moments.conclusion: The market may see limited upside before consolidating further.

moments.claim: Bitcoin remains vulnerable to a macro downtrend unless it reclaims critical market-turning levels.
moments.details: Reviewing the Bitcoin chart, the speaker highlights descending channel structures and warns that recent bounces might only represent corrective rallies within a larger macro downturn.
moments.surprise: Current price patterns suggest the possibility of another macro leg lower rather than an immediate bull market continuation.
moments.scenario: If key resistance levels cannot be reclaimed, the market continues its broader macroeconomic correction.
moments.conclusion: Traders should remain objective and let the charts dictate positioning rather than relying on emotional bias.

predictions: Bitcoin may enter another multi-week bounce or start a new bull market phase following recent low tests.

Bitcoin may continue its macro downtrend if key resistance levels are not reclaimed.
curiosities: Bear market rallies in Bitcoin historically take twice as long in duration as the drops that preceded them.
Interest rate hike expectations remain near 100 percent despite significant market corrections.
title: Bitcoin: This Is Why Price ISN'T Going Up (Double Bluff Low)
author: Jason Pizzino
